security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tiles.openfreemap.org; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://tiles.openfreemap.org; worker-src 'self' blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: AI-assisted indoor cycling with smart-trainer control and map rides
bundle.longDescription: Ridgeline connects to Bluetooth FTMS smart trainers and sensors, builds a training plan with an offline planner or a local AI model, runs structured ERG workouts and rides real mapped routes with elevation-based trainer simulation. Local-first; no account required.
